clusters.headline: President Prabowo Seeks Vice Presidential Nominees From Coalition
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto has instructed coalition parties to deliberate on potential vice presidential candidates within one week.
Two final names are required to be submitted to the People's Consultative Assembly for the replacement of Gibran.

clusters.headline: Sufmi Dasco Ahmad Comments On Growing Vice Presidential Support
aiSummaryBullets: Sufmi Dasco Ahmad has acknowledged calls for him to serve as vice president but emphasized the necessity of respecting the President's authority to propose candidates.
Various political figures, regional groups, and labor unions have publicly voiced support for his candidacy, citing his professional background and communication skills.

clusters.headline: Indonesian National Police Initiate Ethics Hearings On Wiretapping
aiSummaryBullets: Professional ethics hearings have commenced for Inspector General Eko Hadi Santoso regarding his involvement in the presidential wiretapping case.
The Indonesian National Police have scheduled a separate ethics hearing for former police chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo for the upcoming week.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Upgrade Treason Case Probe Against Listyo Sigit
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police have transitioned the investigation into alleged treason to the formal inquiry stage.
The case involves accusations of illegal surveillance and the destruction of electronic evidence targeting President Prabowo Subianto.

clusters.headline: New Javan Rhino Calf Born As Relocation Proposals Face Scrutiny
aiSummaryBullets: A Javan rhino calf was recently recorded by camera traps in Ujung Kulon National Park.
The Indonesian House of Representatives has initiated a formal review of proposals to relocate the rhino population to Alas Purwo.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Expands International And Regional Partnerships
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo proposed strategic collaborations with South Korea in the energy and semiconductor sectors.
ASEAN member states reached a consensus on utilizing space technology to support regional economic growth and disaster mitigation efforts.

clusters.headline: University Of Indonesia Denies Plans For School In City Forest
aiSummaryBullets: University of Indonesia officials stated that the Sekolah Rakyat project will not be constructed within the campus city forest area.
Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung clarified that he did not propose the university's forest as a site for the social project.

clusters.headline: KPK Expands Investigations Into Ongoing ATR/BPN Corruption Case
aiSummaryBullets: The KPK has summoned regional heads of the Land and Spatial Planning Agency for questioning as witnesses.
Investigations are ongoing regarding allegations of bribery and the unauthorized disclosure of case-related documents.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Customs Officials Sentenced Following Import Bribery Case
aiSummaryBullets: Three former customs officials were recently sentenced to prison terms ranging from six to nine years for their involvement in bribery.
The Corruption Eradication Commission is actively pursuing new leads, including the questioning of additional suspects linked to customs corruption.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Engages In Regional Talks At ASEAN Summit
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto detailed Indonesia's plan to construct solar power plants with a 100-gigawatt capacity.
The Indonesian president called for ASEAN nations to evolve into technology industry leaders rather than acting primarily as consumer markets.

clusters.headline: Geological Agency Confirms No Tsunami Risk After Banda Sea Quake
aiSummaryBullets: A 7.1 magnitude earthquake struck the Banda Sea in Maluku on Tuesday morning.
Indonesian meteorological and geological agencies confirmed the event poses no tsunami risk.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Legislators Advance Several Proposed Legislative Bills
aiSummaryBullets: Legislators proposed including a bill regarding artificial intelligence regulation in the 2027 mid-term national legislation program.
Parliament is gathering public and expert feedback on a draft bill concerning wiretapping procedures.

clusters.headline: Government Mandates 2027 Minimum Wage Determination By November
aiSummaryBullets: Provincial minimum wages must be finalized by November 21, 2026.
Municipal minimum wages are required to be established by November 25, 2026.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Vice President Resignation Causes Impeachment Vote Halt
aiSummaryBullets: The planned parliamentary impeachment proceedings against the Vice President were canceled following his formal resignation.
The House of Representatives subsequently held plenary meetings to address legislative matters rather than the impeachment motion.

clusters.headline: Police Advance Investigation Into Kupang Regent Rape Allegations
aiSummaryBullets: Police in East Nusa Tenggara have seized clothing items as evidence following an inspection of the Kupang Regent's official residence.
Regional Police Chief Irjen Pol. Reza Arief Dewanto committed to conducting a transparent investigation without external interference.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Attorney General To Question Bekasi Mayor In KSO Case
aiSummaryBullets: The Attorney General's Office summoned the Mayor of Bekasi, Tri Adhianto, for questioning regarding a joint operation case.
The inquiry is part of an ongoing investigation into alleged corruption involving the management of city-owned energy enterprises.

clusters.headline: Indonesian National Police Investigate Possible Masterminds In Wiretap
aiSummaryBullets: Police are currently examining potential figures who may have orchestrated or supported the illegal wiretapping of President Prabowo.
A special task force has been established to analyze evidence and investigate individuals linked to the suspect previously identified as LSP.

clusters.headline: Police Investigation Continues Into Jakarta Mosque Morning Attack
aiSummaryBullets: Law enforcement has detained a suspect and seized items including an axe and gasoline used during the mosque assault.
The suspect faces formal charges and potential imprisonment of up to nine years as police evaluate their mental health status.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Officials Address Fuel Subsidy Costs And Market Prices
aiSummaryBullets: Government officials confirm that fuel subsidy allocations remain secure for the remainder of 2026 despite rising global oil prices.
Finance Ministry representatives stated that market prices for Pertalite and Solar fuels significantly exceed the current subsidized consumer rates.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Gold Prices Experience Decline In Mid-November Trading
aiSummaryBullets: Antam gold prices decreased by Rp7,000 to reach Rp2,515,000 per gram as of November 17, 2026.
Pegadaian reported simultaneous price reductions across three major gold brands in its Tuesday morning update.
